Definition: to issue; causatively, to bring out
BiblicalUsage: The decree goes forth that the wise men should be slain, and Cyrus brings out the vessels of gold and silver from the temple of Babylon to return them to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe going forth and bringing out are God's two movements: the decree goes out to kill, and the vessels come out to live again, and the same king's word cannot stop either one.
